overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Everything on AutoSouk, and what waits for you.

queues.title: Waiting for you
queues.verificationsHint: Face videos and mechanic documents, decided together

queue.title: Verifications
queue.description: Everything people sent to be verified, decided in one place: the face video, and a mechanic's documents.
queue.caption: People waiting for a check
queue.empty: Nobody is waiting. New face videos and documents show up here.
queue.note: Longest waiting first. Mechanics can send their documents as soon as their face video is sent, so you usually decide both together.

face.title: Face video
face.linkValid: The link lasts 10 minutes. Reload the page if it stops.
face.challengesHint: The user saw them one by one while recording.

checklist.title: Before approving, check
checklist.live: The same real person all along, not a photo or a screen
checklist.challenges: Each challenge is done, in the order asked
checklist.clear: The face is clear: good light, nothing covering it
checklist.cinMatches: The name and face on the CIN match the account and the face video

decision.label: Decision on the face video
decision.reasonLabel: Reason for rejecting the face video
decision.reasonHelper: The user reads it in the email and on their face check page, and can record again.
decision.footerAll: One email tells {{name}} what was approved and what to send again, with your reasons. The video and rejected files are deleted.
decision.askAgain_one: Save and ask for {{count}} item again
decision.askAgain_other: Save and ask for {{count}} items again

presets.tooDark: We can't see your face well: it's too dark. Record again facing a window or a lamp.
presets.faceHidden: Something hides part of your face. Remove glasses, a cap or a mask, and record again.
presets.challengeMissed: You didn't do every challenge on the screen. Follow each one, in order.
presets.notLive: This doesn't look like a live recording. Record yourself, not a photo or a screen.

list.title: Users
list.description: Every account. Suspend or delete one from its page.
list.caption: Accounts

detail.inspectionsRequested: Inspections asked for as a buyer
detail.noHistory: No admin action on this account yet.

suspendDialog.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspendDialog.description: The account keeps its data. You can lift the suspension at any time.
consequences: Signed out of every device now, and can't sign in again
Buyers stop seeing the account's listings and workshop
Gets an email with your reason, and another one if you lift the suspension
suspendDialog.label: Why are you suspending this account?
suspendDialog.helper: Sent to the user by email, in their language, and kept in the audit log.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.description: This can't be undone. To keep the data, suspend the account instead.
consequences: Listings, cars, photos and favourites are deleted
Inspections the account asked for are deleted, with their reports
Face videos and documents are deleted from storage
Buyers keep the inspections of the account's cars, with their reports
deleteDialog.label: Why are you deleting this account?
deleteDialog.helper: Kept in the audit log, with the name and email.

detail.reactivated: The suspension is lifted. We emailed {{name}}.
detail.suspended: Account suspended. We emailed {{name}} the reason.

listings.title: Listings
listings.description: Every listing in every status. Open a pending one to check its car and photos, then approve or reject it.
listings.caption: Listings
listings.searchPlaceholder: A title, or a seller's name or email
listings.hiddenNote: Listings of a suspended seller stay here, and are hidden from buyers until the suspension is lifted.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
consequences: The listing, its car, photos and videos are deleted
Buyers keep the car's inspections and their reports
Inspections not finished yet are cancelled
deleteDialog.label: Why are you deleting this listing?
deleteDialog.helper: Kept in the audit log, with the title and seller.

listings.approved: “{{title}}” is approved and visible to buyers.
listings.rejected: “{{title}}” was sent back to its seller.

rejectDialog.title: Reject “{{title}}”?
rejectDialog.description: The listing stays with its seller, hidden from buyers.
consequences: The seller sees your reason on the listing
Once the seller edits it, it comes back here for review
rejectDialog.label: What should the seller fix?
rejectDialog.helper: Shown to the seller as you write it.

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.description: Every workshop, bookable or not. Buyers only see the bookable ones.
workshops.caption: Workshops
workshops.searchPlaceholder: A workshop, or an owner's name or email
workshops.bookableNote: Buyers can book a workshop once its owner's face check is approved, its documents are approved and still valid, and the account isn't suspended.

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.description: Every inspection, from the request to the report.
inspections.caption: Inspections
inspections.deletedNote: When a listing or a seller is deleted, the car's inspections stay here with the car's name. Buyers keep their reports, and unfinished inspections are cancelled.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Who saw or decided what, newest first. Entries can't be changed or removed.
auditLog.caption: Audit log
auditLog.note: Every decision, suspension, deletion, and every face video or document opened is written here. A deleted account or listing keeps its name or title here.
